details.description: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct-Turbo is Together AI's FP8-quantized, serverless-optimized build of Alibaba Cloud's Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, a 7.61-billion-parameter instruction-tuned chat model that Qwen released in September 2024 as part of its Qwen2.5 family. On Together AI it serves a 32,768-token context window with function calling and JSON mode, and Qwen positions it for chat, coding, mathematics and long-text generation. Qwen states the broader Qwen2.5 line supports over 29 languages.
advantages: Scores 91.6 on GSM8K and 75.5 on MATH, per Qwen's official Qwen2.5 benchmark results.
Scores 84.8 on HumanEval and 79.2 on MBPP for code generation, per Qwen's official benchmark results.
Scores 56.3 on MMLU-Pro and 71.2 (strict prompt) on IFEval, per Qwen's official benchmark results.
Supports function calling and JSON mode for structured outputs, per Together AI's model page.
disadvantages: Context window is capped at 32,768 tokens in this Together AI Turbo deployment, while the base Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model card describes a longer 131,072-token configuration.
Smaller than other Qwen2.5 sizes (14B-72B), which Qwen's own benchmark tables show scoring higher on most of the same evaluations (the 14B model scores slightly lower on HumanEval).
use_cases: Function calling and structured JSON output for agent and tool-use workflows

sources.title: Qwen2.5-LLM: Extending the boundary of LLMs
Qwen2.5 7B Instruct Turbo API: Pricing, Benchmarks & Docs | Together AI

notes: Catalog's 32,768 max_input_tokens matches Together AI's 'Context Length: 32K tokens' spec for this Turbo deployment; the base Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model card separately states a longer 131,072-token context in other configurations, which is not reflected in this catalog figure. Qwen states multilingual support only as a count ('over 29 languages') alongside a partial, non-exhaustive example list, so languages were left empty per instructions.
